cards.text: Pay your partner three compliments, each about something different. Make them count.
Hold your partner's gaze for ten seconds without laughing.
Look into each other's eyes for one full minute. No talking, no giggling.
Kiss your partner's hand, then the inside of their wrist. Take your time.
Tell your partner the moment you first realised you fancied them.
Whisper something sweet in your partner's ear. A smile from them earns you a point.
Take turns giving each other compliments, five rounds each. No repeats.
Give your partner a slow, lingering kiss on the cheek, then another on the forehead.
Trace a word on your partner's back with one fingertip. They get three guesses.
Tell your partner what you noticed first about them, and what you notice most now.
Sway together for one minute, as close as you can get, with no music needed.
Rub your partner's shoulders for thirty seconds, then ask for a review of your technique.
Tell your partner your favourite thing about their laugh, then try to set it off.
Run your fingers through your partner's hair for a full minute.
Confess the cheekiest thought you had about your partner this week.
Hold hands and each share a favourite memory of the other. One minute each.
Kiss your partner once, just below the ear. Then act completely innocent.
Stroke your partner's cheek and tell them what you love about their smile.
Wink at your partner, then hold your best smouldering look for five seconds.
Whisper one thing you secretly love about each other, both at once, on the count of three.
Kiss your partner softly on each eyelid. Slowly.
Kiss your partner's nose, chin and forehead, in any order, with a grin.
Invent a pet name for your partner. They vote on whether it stays.
Share one slow kiss, then each rate it out of ten. Be honest, and kind.
Give your partner a long, warm hug and say what you're most grateful for. Don't let go first.
Chat up your partner for thirty seconds using the cheesiest lines you know.
Sit back to back, take three slow breaths together, then turn round and smile.
Tell your partner your favourite memory of the two of you, holding their hand throughout.
Tickle your partner's palm with one fingertip for twenty seconds, then kiss it better.
Blow your partner a kiss across the room, then walk over and deliver the real thing.
Tell each other your first impression of the other. Be honest, be sweet.
Cuddle up for two minutes and take turns whispering one thing you want to do together soon.
Give your partner a two-minute massage of their shoulders and neck. Slow thumbs only.
Kiss your partner's neck, slowly, from the collarbone up to the ear.
Take turns kissing each other's necks for one minute each. No hands allowed.
Slowly take off one layer of your partner's clothing. Stop the moment they say so.
Whisper in your partner's ear one thing you want tonight. Keep it low and keep them guessing.
Run your fingertips up your partner's arm to the shoulder, then do the other arm. Slowly.
Sit facing each other and trace each other's faces with your fingertips for one minute, eyes closed.
Kiss a trail up your partner's arm from wrist to shoulder. Take your time.
Give your partner a two-minute back massage. They tell you when it's perfect.
Trace your partner's collarbone with a fingertip, then with your lips.
Swap shoulder massages, two minutes each. The one receiving gives the feedback.
Sit hip to hip and run a hand over your partner's thigh, over their clothes, for thirty seconds.
Ask your partner where above the waist they most like to be kissed. Do it for thirty seconds.
Rest a hand on the small of your partner's back and pull them in for a slow kiss.
Kiss your partner's ear, then whisper what you're thinking. Keep it cheeky.
Take turns whispering what you'd most like to happen tonight. Two rounds each.
Slowly undo one button of your partner's top, then give them a look and stop.
Lean in for a kiss, stop a breath away, and hold it there for ten seconds.
Kiss behind your partner's ear, along the jaw, then stop just short of their lips. Smile.
Kiss slowly for one minute, keeping your hands on each other's shoulders only.
Massage your partner's hands for a minute, one finger at a time.
Name the spot above the waist you find hardest to resist on your partner, and kiss it.
Slide your hands slowly up your partner's back, over their clothes, and draw them close.
Lie close, side by side, and trace slow patterns on each other's backs for two minutes.
Whisper three words for how you feel right now, then show them with a kiss.
Run your hands slowly down your partner's sides, ribs to hips, over their clothes. Twice.
Take turns removing one layer of each other's clothing, slowly. Either of you can say stop.
Nibble your partner's earlobe softly, just once, then pretend nothing happened.
Give your partner a two-minute foot rub, then ask how they plan to say thank you.
Kiss each of your partner's fingertips, slowly, with your eyes on theirs.
Take turns choosing a spot above the waist for the other to kiss. Three each.
Kiss for a full minute, pausing only to whisper one thing you'd like next.
Kiss a slow line from your partner's neck to their collarbone, then back again. Take a full minute.
Kiss your partner's shoulder, then the side of their neck, then behind the ear. Each kiss slower than the last.
Take turns tracing each other's lips with a fingertip, then with a kiss. Two rounds each.
Lift your partner's top a little and kiss their stomach for twenty seconds. Stop if they ask, then look up and grin.
Kiss slowly from your partner's lips to their ear, then whisper something you'd like to try.
Tease your partner's lips with yours for thirty seconds without quite kissing them.
Kiss each other's necks at the same time for thirty seconds. See who gives in first.
Kiss your partner's hip over their clothes, then look up and ask what's next.
Kiss your partner's thigh over their clothes, then make your way slowly back up for a proper kiss.
Kiss your partner's neck with soft, lingering lips for thirty seconds, no rushing.
Take turns kissing a spot on the other while they keep their eyes closed and guess where it is.
Kiss the nape of your partner's neck, then where the shoulder meets it. Linger for twenty seconds.
Kiss your partner's chest, slowly, for thirty seconds, and listen for their heartbeat.
Hold your partner's face and give them short, soft kisses for sixty seconds, each one a little longer than the last.
Kiss slowly down the back of your partner's neck and along their spine, as far as their top allows. Stop if they ask.
Kiss for one minute with your hands behind your backs. Lips only, and either of you can end it.
Ask your partner to point to a spot above the waist where they'd like your lips next, and give it thirty seconds.
Kiss your partner's lips, then their jaw, then the hollow of their throat. Eyes closed, no hurry.
Brush your lips across your partner's shoulders, as lightly as you can, for a minute.
Take turns whispering where above the waist you'd like to be kissed next, then do it for each other. Two rounds each.
Kiss your partner through their clothes, from chest to stomach, for thirty seconds. Let them wonder where you're headed.
Kiss the inside of your partner's knee, then work up to the thigh and stop there. Ask if they want more.
Whisper the thing you most enjoy about kissing your partner, then prove it.
Take turns kissing a slow path down each other's chest and stomach. Two minutes each, no rushing.
Kiss your partner's lower lip, then the upper, then the corner of their mouth, until they pull you in.
Kiss slowly along your partner's jawline from one ear to the other, via the chin.
Trade kisses back and forth, taking turns to start each one. Ten each, getting longer every time.
Kiss your partner's lips, pause a breath away and whisper what you'd like next. Do it three times.
Breathe warm air on your partner's neck, then follow it with a kiss.
Choose a spot on your partner you haven't kissed tonight and linger there for a full minute.
Take turns teasing: lean in, almost kiss, pull back. Three rounds each, then give in.
Kiss your way along each other's arms, fingertips to shoulder. One arm each, then swap.
Take charge for the next five minutes and decide what happens. Check your partner is happy at every step.
Describe the rest of your evening together in a low voice. Keep it teasing and leave out the details.
Take turns leading for three minutes each. The follower goes along with it, and either of you can say stop.
Let your partner choose slow or fast for the next three kisses. Say stop whenever you like.
Tell your partner you plan to be in charge tonight, then back it up with a kiss they'll remember. They can say stop any time.
Pull your partner in by the waist and kiss them hungrily for one minute, hands roaming over their clothes. Stop if they ask.
Each whisper the one thing you most want the other to do next. Then do both, one after the other.
Take your partner by the hand and lead them somewhere more comfortable. Pause there and let it build.
Give your partner three simple instructions for where to put their hands, above the waist. They can follow, or say not tonight.
Look your partner up and down slowly, then tell them what you'd do with a whole night. Keep it a tease.
Agree on a pace for tonight: slow, steady or wild. Then start as you mean to go on.
Pull your partner onto your lap and kiss them with intent for one minute. Check they're happy first.
Whisper which you prefer, a slow build or a sudden rush, and why. Your partner scores your answer.
Guide your partner's hands to your waist, then kiss them slowly and keep them there for a minute.
Take off one more layer yourself, slowly, with your eyes on your partner. Then ask what they think.
Dim the lights and hold each other close without speaking for one minute. Then decide what happens next, together.
Ask your partner to pick a number from one to ten for how bold you'll be next. Then do exactly that.
Count down from five, kissing your partner on every number, and make the last kiss the longest.
Whisper a three-word promise for later in your partner's ear, then kiss their neck for thirty seconds. Stop if they ask.
Take turns finishing the sentence "tonight I'd like you to..." three times each.
Tell your partner what you'd wear less of right now, and why it would help.
Kiss your partner slowly for two minutes, hands roaming over their clothes, and don't speed up until they ask. Stop if they say.
Trace a path with one fingertip from your partner's neck down to their waist, then stop and smile. Ask if they want more.
Each take off one more layer at the same time, eyes locked. Stop whenever either of you wants.
Dim the lights and tell your partner you're setting the mood for the next ten minutes. Check they're happy at every step.
Hint at the bold thing you've been wanting to try without spelling it out. Your partner gets one guess.
Take turns choosing the next thing you both do, with a kiss between every choice. Five rounds.
Pull your partner flush against you and move together slowly for a minute, hands wherever they're welcome. Stop if either asks.
Take your partner's hand and slide it slowly down your chest, over your clothes, then hold their eyes. Stop if either of you asks.
Tell your partner where you'd like the night to end up, then set off in that direction with a kiss.
Pick a word that means stop, then spend five minutes as bold as you both like, over your clothes.
Whisper your favourite night together to each other, then recreate just the first kiss from it. Stop whenever either of you likes.
